about: A self-hosted app for saving web pages to read later.

prs.title: Bookmarks imported from Shaarli and Pocket keep their titles
prs.broken: The Shaarli and Pocket imports dropped each bookmark's title. When the page could not be fetched, like a dead link, the saved entry had no title at all.
prs.changed: The link text from the export file is now passed as the title, as the Chrome and Firefox imports already do.
prs.matters: Moving old bookmarks into wallabag keeps their names, even for pages that are gone.
